blockingIssues.problem: The rationale asserts that numbered lockers caused the decline in lost-item reports, but the source explicitly says it does not isolate a cause and notes other changes (staffing and opening hours) during the trial.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: 'Six stations tried numbered lockers in July; lost-item reports fell from 18 to 11. Staffing and opening hours also changed. The note does not isolate a cause. No decision about expansion has been made.'
blockingIssues.constraint: The idea must not present the observed drop in lost-item reports as established evidence that numbered lockers were the cause; any causal connection must be framed as unproven or attributed to the source's uncertainty.
